headlines.title: 글로벌 금융위기 이후 최고…‘ 채권 포비아 ’ 글로벌 확산
headlines.summary: 美 국채 30년물 금리 5.2% 英·日·獨·佛도 연일 치솟아 서울 하나은행 딜링룸에 원달러 환율, 코스피가 보이는 가운데 왼편에 치솟은 미국 국채가 표기돼 있다. [연합뉴스] 이란 전쟁 장기화에 따른 인플레이션 공포로 대표적 안전자산인 미국 국채를 비롯해 주요국 채권에 대한 투매가 확산되고 있다.

headlines.title: 파국은 피했다 …삼성전자 노사 '성과급 협상' 잠정 합의
headlines.summary: 155일 만에 협상 타결 특별경영성과급 10.5% 지급 반도체부문에 전액 자사주로 22~27일 조합원 찬반 투표 < 정부 중재로 총파업 유보 > 삼성전자 노사가 20일 성과급 제도 개선안에 극적으로 합의했다.

headlines.title: 반도체 셧다운 막았다 … 노사 성과급 제도화·배분율 전격 합의

headlines.title: 삼성전자 협상 결렬 …사측 “노조 요구 과도” 노조 “총파업 돌입”
headlines.summary: [앵커] 삼성전자 노사의 협상이 마라톤 협상에도 불구하고 오늘 오전 결국 결렬됐습니다. 사측은 노조의 요구가 과도하다고 했고,  노조는 중노위의 조정안에 사측이 거부했다는 입장입니다. 노조는 내일 예정했던 총파업에 돌입하기로 했습니다. 문예슬 기자가 보도합니다.

headlines.title: 삼성전자 노사협상 발묶인 사이, 中반도체 반사이익
headlines.summary: [삼성전자 파업 직전 유보] 양대 메모리업체 CXMT-YMTC 기업공개 추진하며 실탄 준비 韓노사갈등 이후 주가도 급등 23일 경기 평택시 고덕동 삼성전자 평택캠퍼스에서 열린 삼성전자 노동조합 공동투쟁본부 ‘4·23 투쟁 결의대회’에서 조합원들이 구호를 외치고 있다. 2026.4.23.

headlines.title: 엔화 아니라 달러 빌린다 … 한·일 통화스와프 재연장 촉각
headlines.summary: 달러 기반 계약… 금융안정에 도움 이재명 대통령과 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리가 19일 경북 안동 한 호텔에서 소인수 정상회담을 하고 있다. 연합뉴스 11월 만료되는 ‘한·일 통화스와프’ 연장 여부에 관심이 쏠리고 있다. 최근 한·일 정상회담에서 양국은 이 문제를 공식 의제로 다루지는 않았으나 금융안전망 보강 차원에서 재연장 가능성이 거론되고 있다.

headlines.title: 한·일 ‘ 원유·석유제품 스와프 ’ 추진 배경 은?… 한국 은 정제 , 일본은...
headlines.summary: 한·일 정상회담 에너지 협력 성과 일본, 지진 위험에 정제 기능 약해 중동 사태 후 한국 제품 다량 수입 환적 등 원유 수급 강점 있는 일본 업계 “유사시 서로에게 도움 될 것” 이재명 대통령이 19일 경북 안동의 한 호텔에 마련된 정상회담장에서 다카이치 사나에 일본총리와 확대 정상회담에 앞서 악수를 하고 있다. 2026.5.

headlines.title: 韓 유조선 호르무즈 통과 로 체류 선원 9명↓…116명 남아

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

오늘 경제 흐름의 핵심은 **글로벌 불균형의 재부상**과 그에 따른 **금융시장의 불확실성 확대**로 요약된다. 미국의 경상수지 적자와 주요국 간 무역·자본 불균형이 다시 심화되는 '글로벌 불균형 시즌 2' 국면에 접어들면서, 환율과 금리 등 거시 변수에 대한 경계감이 높아지고 있다. 이러한 환경 속에서 금리 상승으로 채권의 투자 매력도는 크게 부각되고 있으나, **델타(불확실성 리스크 요인)** 의 존재가 적극적인 채권 매수를 주저하게 만드는 걸림돌로 작용하고 있다. 결국 오늘의 시장은 *매력적인 투자 기회*와 *해소되지 않은 리스크* 사이에서 방향성을 탐색하는 모습이며, 글로벌 구조적 변화에 대한 면밀한 모니터링이 필요한 시점이다.

key_headlines.title: Lee Government Marks One Year Anniversary with Strong Economic Performance
key_headlines.summary: President Lee Jae-myung's administration celebrates its first year with Korea achieving OECD-leading Q1 growth rate, rising export rankings to 5th globally, and maintaining inflation at 2% level.

key_headlines.title: Producer Price Index Hits 28-Year High Amid Middle East Crisis
key_headlines.summary: April producer prices surged 6.9% year-over-year, the highest in 3.5 years, driven by soaring crude oil and raw material costs due to prolonged Middle East conflict.

key_headlines.title: Deputy PM Koo Emphasizes Global Imbalance Mitigation at G7 Meeting
key_headlines.summary: Finance Minister Koo Yun-cheol attended the G7 finance ministers meeting in Paris to discuss global economic challenges including Middle East war impacts and currency volatility.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Jeonse Housing Market Hits Crisis; Monthly Rent Prices Reach Record Highs
key_headlines.summary: With jeonse (lump-sum deposit) properties disappearing from the market, Seoul apartment and villa monthly rental prices have reached all-time highs, intensifying housing burden for renters.

key_headlines.title: US Federal Reserve Signals Possible Rate Hikes if Inflation Persists
key_headlines.summary: April FOMC minutes reveal growing hawkish sentiment among Fed officials, with multiple members warning of potential rate increases if inflation remains above 2% target.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economic performance under the Lee Jae-myung administration marks a notable turnaround after the martial law shock, achieving the highest Q1 growth rate among OECD major economies. The government has achieved record export rankings (5th globally) and market capitalization (8th globally), while maintaining inflation within the 2% target range. Tax revenues increased significantly by 41.5 trillion won compared to the previous year, demonstrating strong fiscal performance. The administration adopted a new slogan emphasizing 'recovery and growth' as it completes its first anniversary, though experts note the need for accelerated structural reforms going forward.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea's latest data shows April producer prices rose 6.9% year-over-year, marking the highest increase in 3.5 years and the largest monthly jump (2.5%) since the 1998 Asian financial crisis. The surge is primarily driven by the Middle East conflict's impact on crude oil and raw material prices, with coal and petroleum products jumping 73.9% year-over-year. Market analysts from Hana Securities project the May monetary policy committee will maintain current interest rates, though minority voices may advocate for rate increases given upward economic growth forecasts. Raw material price pressures are expected to gradually flow into consumer prices with a time lag, creating inflation concerns for policymakers.
sections.Financial Markets: Domestic equity markets experienced significant volatility with buy-side circuit breakers activating on KOSPI and KOSDAQ amid labor strike risks and global uncertainty. International crude oil prices and US treasury yields fell sharply following ceasefire expectations and weaker-than-expected labor market data, prompting a sharp rebound in US equity markets. The Fed's April FOMC minutes revealed increasingly hawkish sentiment, with growing numbers of officials warning of potential rate hikes if inflation persists above 2%, creating mixed signals for investors. Both stock and bond markets face headwinds from elevated real interest rates, currency volatility, and semiconductor sector weakness, with extreme market swings expected to persist.
sections.Industry & Technology: The Ministry of SMEs is creating specialized innovation districts focused on AI, space, energy, and future mobility sectors, enabling startups to directly commercialize technologies in automotive, shipbuilding, and petrochemical industries through open testbed environments. SEC Semiconductor announced growth strategies centered on HBM, defense, and battery sectors, targeting 111.6 billion won in sales by 2027 amid accelerating AI chip demand and adoption of X-ray inspection technology. Researchers at UNIST developed 'MXene,' a revolutionary material enabling electromagnetic shielding and battery applications simultaneously, positioning it as a dream material for 6G communications and advanced battery technology. The government is also promoting Korean AI and robotics exports to Vietnam, with increased local demand following recent bilateral leadership visits.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's rental housing market faces unprecedented crisis as traditional jeonse properties disappear, with both apartment and villa monthly rent prices reaching record highs despite reduced supply and increased tenant displacement. Co-living residential models are rapidly expanding as an alternative, with Seoul-based co-living investments doubling over the past year, offering managed shared living spaces targeting single-person households. Gimpo's Wangsuk 2 district launched Korea's first privately-developed public housing supply project with reasonable rental prices, aiming to address housing affordability concerns. Housing prices show signs of stabilization with Seoul apartment prices rising for three consecutive weeks, though transaction volumes remain subdued as buyers adopt cautious wait-and-see strategies despite healthy fundamentals in reconstruction-planned complexes.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve's April FOMC minutes reveal a significant hawkish shift, with majority of officials warning of potential rate increases if inflation persists above the 2% target, contradicting earlier pivot expectations. Recent ceasefire hopes in the Middle East prompted sharp declines in crude oil prices and US Treasury yields, with international oil prices falling over 5% and reducing inflation concerns. China and the United States agreed on mutual 30 billion dollar tariff reductions following Trump's recent summit with President Xi Jinping, though broader trade tensions and tariff escalation risks remain. The labor market's stronger-than-expected April jobs report (115,000 new positions) reinforced economic resilience but also validated the Fed's more cautious stance on rate cuts.
sections.AI & Economy: DL Construction won contracts for the Bucheon Samsung AI Hub Center, continuing its dominance in the data center infrastructure market driven by AI sector expansion. Korea Investment & Securities' AI-powered real-time market analysis service achieved 10 million views in just one month, reflecting surging investor demand for AI-driven insights amid elevated market volatility. SpaceX is targeting a mid-June NASDAQ listing with a mega-IPO, projecting a 28.5 trillion dollar total addressable market, positioning AI and space industries at an inflection point. Labor market experts emphasize that Korea's labor market must increase flexibility and strengthen safety nets during AI transformation, including extended unemployment benefits up to 20 additional weeks during economic downturns.
sections.Others: The Financial Services Commission announced temporary regulatory relaxation for network security AI applications starting next month, recognizing limitations of network segregation rules in the rapidly evolving AI transformation era. Celltrion decided on a 109.2 million share stock dividend and additional 100 billion won in share buybacks, leveraging its biosimilar-driven cash generation capabilities. New Zealand's right-wing government led by Prime Minister Christopher Luxon plans to reduce civil service by 14% (8,700 positions) through comprehensive public sector restructuring and fiscal austerity measures, aiming to improve administrative efficiency through organizational consolidation and AI adoption. The United States-Iran conflict remains in fragile ceasefire after three months, with fundamental peace negotiations stalled despite Trump's tactical decisions to delay further military actions.
